messages:
Marta: Quick thread 15m to agree acceptance criteria for catalog onboarding pilot. Need to resolve metrics, timeline, and customer pin policy.

Vik: Keep default lightweight: docs + smoke perf (48-72h). Pilot customers can buy an extended run.

Dee (sales): Pilot customer (HealthCo) wants a guarantee on p95 during canary. They'll pay if we commit. Need clear thresholds.

Omar: Proposal for pilot acceptance:
- smoke pass (no runtime exceptions on 5k sample)
- perf: p95 within 1.5x of internal baseline for their region
- accuracy: no >4% drop vs their reference set
- deliverable: compatibility report + canary plan

Marta: Pin policy for pilot: allow 60-day pin opt-in. Alerts at 30/15/7 days. Post-pin migration requires staged canary (2% -> 10% -> 100%).

Dee (sales): Contract note: if we're promising p95, legal wants capped credits. Also confirm we won't rework customer prompts as part of scope.

Omar: Ops note: reserving Dedicated for canary is optional but recommended for strict p95. If customer insists, charge a reservation fee.

qa-bot: Reminder: create QA ticket QA-774 for pilot test harness.

Marta: Action items: Vik to draft thresholds by EOD Thu, Dee to get HealthCo to sign pilot T&C, Omar to estimate infra cost. Reconvene Fri 10am. :thumbsup:
